official_definition: You can target and attack an opposing Spirit/Ultimate. This effect can't be prevented by opposing effects. Also, at the end of the battle, for each symbol this Spirit has, send an opposing Life to the Reserve.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Vermillion Furious Charge] or [Vermillion Furious Charge: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Vermillion Furious Charge]", "give [Vermillion Furious Charge]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Enables direct targeting of opposing Spirit/Ultimate during attack step.
